title: CGTrader Christmas 3D Print Challenge
author: ameskwm
selftext:
If u’re already modeling and messing around with printable stuff, CGTrader is running a christmas challenge right now that’s honestly pretty low friction. The theme is anything christmas related, like ornaments, decorations, festive props, small figures, etc, as long as the model is **new to the marketplace**.

All they ask is:

* christmas themed model
* uploaded new to CGTrader
* at least one photo of an actual print

The nice part is the rewards arent just printer supplies, there are **cash prizes**, which from what ive seen the community actually prefers. If u already print your work or were planning a holiday-themed piece anyway, it feels like an easy win to just polish one thing and submit it.

Might be worth taking a look if u want to turn a december side project into something with a bit of upside. Enrollment is on the CGTrader challenge page.
